items: One reducer input mixes clicks and profiles for the same user
Arrival order inside the group is arbitrary: profile may come last
The reducer cannot emit a click before it has seen the profile
cards.title: The Mixed Contract

items: Secondary sort orders the group: profile first, then clicks by ts
With profile-first, the reducer streams with O(1) state again
This ordering is required by the mixed contract, not by the two-stream one
cards.title: Profile-First or Buffer

items: Without the ordering, clicks wait in a buffer until the profile lands
A huge group can overflow the buffer: the same OOM in a new place
Name the contract before choosing the mechanism
cards.title: Buffering Has a Price

meta.title: Mixed Reducer Stream: Profile-First or Buffer
